svg.title: Cooling architecture and unresolved interfaces
svg.text: Keep cooling water outside the tuned gas path
Concept only · flow, pressure, vents and drainage require installation design
Measure flow + inlet/outlet temperature + jacket hot spots + hull temperature.
If wet discharge is adopted: assess backflow, siphoning, heel, capsize and shutdown drainage.
An aft-facing injection nozzle alone is not protection against water entering the cylinder.
Exposed flange and stinger still need thermal protection; jacket performance is not yet established.
